name: Changdeng Manye
source:
A young Arboranger who ran away from home and now lives in the Main Beacon, often helping others. She is gentle, kind, and enthusiastic. She seems to have a strong interest in science, technology and the knowledge of ancient Illuminator civilization, and when it comes to related topics, she talks endlessly.

[spoiler]In order to change her older sister's disaproval and attitude towards herself, Genia Cold embarked on a solitary journey to seek knowledge from the Sage Noxistasia Shade, wanting to learn ancient technology and eventually become a technical officer of Light Pollution.

Also, she created Fabrica with Noxistasia's help.[/spoiler]
